title: [finding] `@objectstack/trigger-record-change` TEST_DEBT records 9 while tsc reports 0 — graduation candidate the ratchet deliberately leaves alone
body:
Observed while running the derived gate set for #10746 (full packages closure built, then `pnpm check:type-check-debt --re-measure`, 2026-08-23, tree at `origin/main` merge-base `2f93d0f53`):

> ℹ @objectstack/trigger-record-change: TEST_DEBT records 9, and tsc now reports 0 -- graduation candidate. Onboard it (add `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`, or drop the test exclusion, and delete the ledger entry in the same PR). `--lower` deliberately leaves this one alone: 0 is not a lower ceiling, it is a graduation, and an entry recording 0 fails the structural half of this gate.

The gate's own message names the remedy: onboard the package (add a `typecheck` script or drop the test exclusion) and delete the TEST_DEBT ledger entry in the same PR. Until someone does, the entry holds a 9-error ceiling over a package that is now clean — room for regressions to land in that layer without any gate saying anything (the same surplus class as the ledger's standing `surplus:` note, see https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/6376).

Observation only — no defect today; the run itself was green (`check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK — 33 ledger entr(ies) re-measured … none above its recorded number`). Filed unassigned per the out-of-scope-findings rule; searched open issues for `trigger-record-change` graduation first and found none (nearest siblings are per-package surplus findings like #10615, different package).
